source.name: 전북일보 (Jeonbuk Ilbo): 전북현대, 새 시즌 유니폼 공개…메인 스폰서 'NEXO(넥쏘)'로 교체 [Jeonbuk unveils new kit; front sponsor changes to NEXO]

source.note: NEXO became the front sponsor from the 2025 season and is unchanged in 2026: the club's 2026 launch images (hyundai-motorsfc.com/media/news/100674, SPA page) show NEXO over the HYUNDAI mark on home, away and GK shirts, and match photos through September 2026 show it in league play.

source.name: K League: [전북] 전북현대모터스FC, 세계 최대 구호기구 WFP 새긴 유니폼 입는다 [Jeonbuk to wear WFP logo on shirt]

source.note: Charity logo at the upper centre of the chest since 31 May 2025; WFP is listed among the 2026 uniform partners (Jeonbuk Ilbo, 2026-02-09) and the chest logo is visible on the 2026 launch images and Sept 2026 match photos.

source.name: CEO스코어데일리 (CEO Score Daily): 금호타이어, 전북현대모터스와 공식 파트너십 연장 [Kumho Tire extends official partnership with Jeonbuk]

source.name: K League: [전북] 전북현대, 2025 유니폼 라인업 공개 [Jeonbuk 2025 kit lineup reveal]

source.note: HTWO on the right sleeve from 2025; still a uniform partner in 2026 (Jeonbuk Ilbo, 2026-02-09 list of continuing uniform partners). Per the club's 2026 uniform design guide (shown in fan summaries) the HTWO mark sits lower on the arm.

source.name: 전북일보 (Jeonbuk Ilbo): 전북현대 유니폼 '빼곡'⋯로보틱스랩 모베드 파트너십 체결 [Jeonbuk signs Robotics Lab/MobED partnership]

source.note: Robotics Lab and MobED logos below the back number from the 2026 season; the club's launch photo shows the home shirt back with 'MobED Robotics LAB' new for 2026.

source.quote: 여기에 현대차증권과 네이버의 스포츠 스트리밍 플랫폼 '네이버 치지직'이 신규 파트너로 합류하며, 유니폼 파트너 라인업은 한층 확대됐다

source.quote: 또 올해도 글로벌 스포츠 브랜드 아디다스와 파트너십을 연장하면서
source.note: adidas stays kit manufacturer for 2026 (partnership extended).

summary: adidas 'La Decima' home kit of the K League 1 calendar-year 2026 season, worn in the 2026-27 ACL Elite. The full uniform-partner lineup is from the club's Feb 2026 announcements (largest in club history): NEXO over HYUNDAI on the chest, WFP charity logo upper-centre chest, Kumho Tire on the sleeve, HTWO sleeve, MobED/Robotics Lab under the back number, CHZZK behind the collar, Hyundai Motor Securities right sleeve, Jeonbuk State left sleeve. A separate ACL Elite version (sold from September 2026) drops NEXO for the corporate HYUNDAI mark, moves WFP to the back and drops the MobED/CHZZK/sleeve marks, per fan review photos; match usage confirms the standard version in league play. The chest also carries the 2025 Korea Cup winners patch and the sleeve the 2025 K League champions patch (competition patches, not sponsors).
